_comment: Maps energy-community building names to building names in the footprint
dataset (currently OpenStreetMap; swap in DTCC/Lantmateriet with
confirmed  - name and area both agree with an independent source.
likely     - name is a clear translation but the area is unverified.
ambiguous  - one polygon may cover several of our buildings, or one of
our buildings may map to several polygons. NOT applied.
Only 'confirmed' and 'likely' entries are used by
build_campus_definition.py. Move an entry out of 'ambiguous' once you
have decided which building it is.

ambiguous._sb_note: One 13,599 m2 polygon covers the whole Samhallsbyggnad complex. Split it per building before using.
ambiguous._karhus_note: One 2,033 m2 polygon; three of our buildings claim the kårhus name.
ambiguous._matte_note: One 2,738 m2 polygon. Gamla Matte has a Rhino record giving 2,390 m2, so the OSM polygon is probably Nya Matte or both together.
ambiguous._holterman_note: Also 'Holterman Hostel, hus A' at 288 m2; unclear whether our building is one or both.
ambiguous._gibraltar_note: 253 m2 seems small for a guesthouse with 183 MWh/yr demand. Unverified.
